verdict.rationale: Adyen documents accepting local payment methods/currencies, configuring multiple payout currencies per merchant account, and both local (no SWIFT fee) and cross-border (SWIFT) settlement options, plus flexible payout timing/currency choice — directly supporting charge-local/settle-in-own-currency workflows. However, there's no explicit documentation of FX rate transparency (e.g., disclosed markup, real-time rate reporting) beyond the currency/payout mechanics themselves. Missing for 10: explicit FX rate/markup transparency documentation, independent confirmation of settlement FX handling in practice.
